WhisperOfTheForest.Race.WotF_ForestCraft.label: forest craft
WhisperOfTheForest.Race.WotF_ForestCraft.description: An instinct for handcraft and magical tools. Products made at workbenches without electrical power components gain one quality tier. Work at electrical workbenches runs at 70% speed. Broken electrical machinery is repaired with chalk marks and wooden taps.

WhisperOfTheForest.Race.WotF_FeyAncestry.label: fey ancestry
WhisperOfTheForest.Race.WotF_FeyAncestry.description: A long-lived fey heritage free from age-related chronic disease. After age 20, shorter-lived races age more slowly toward a natural lifespan of roughly 500 years. Meditation restores rest at 90% effectiveness plus the strength of its focus. An assigned meditation spot or trance cushion satisfies the colonist bed requirement.
